scenes.title: Терпение официанта  (A Waiter's Patience)
scenes.summary: Max explains that patience is the most important skill for a waiter after a guest studies the menu for ten minutes only to order coffee.

scenes.title: Спор на чаевые  (A Bet on the Tips)
scenes.summary: Ilya mocks Max over the shared tip pool, and the waiters make a winner-takes-all bet on who can earn the most tips during the next shift.

scenes.title: Розыгрыш для Кати  (A Prank on Katya)
scenes.summary: Nastya wakes up craving food at night, and at the restaurant Senya and Fedya try to prank Katya with a toy mouse.

scenes.title: Торпеда в борт  (A Torpedo to the Hull)
scenes.summary: Katya retaliates against Senya and Fedya's prank, while Chef Barinov talks to Elena on the phone about Nagiyev's surprise.

scenes.title: Умный баран  (A Smart Ram)
scenes.summary: Barinov inspects Timur's fish delivery in the courtyard, and Timur tries to sell him a live ram that his nephew didn't need as a bribe.

scenes.title: Свежий навоз  (Fresh Manure)
scenes.summary: Senya and Fedya buy sheep droppings from Timur for their prank on Katya, while vegetarian Nastya eyes Max's sausage sandwich.

scenes.title: Битва за заказ  (Battle for the Order)
scenes.summary: Nastya secretly eats meat, and in the dining room Ilya takes a bite out of Max's rack of lamb so the guest will complain.

scenes.title: Жемчужины с сюрпризом  (Pearls with a Surprise)
scenes.summary: Senya and Fedya eat Katya's tenderloin with molecular pearls, only to learn she made the pearls from the sheep droppings they planted in her locker.

scenes.title: Природный вкус  (A Natural Taste)
scenes.summary: Nagiyev loves the prank dish and praises Katya's creativity, and Barinov warns the kitchen that nobody must ever tell Nagiyev what he ate.

scenes.title: Принципы Насти  (Nastya's Principles)
scenes.summary: Barinov orders Katya to remake Nagiyev's dish without the prank ingredient, and Nastya confesses to Kostya that she broke her vegetarian principles.

scenes.title: Не то блюдо  (Not That Dish)
scenes.summary: Nagiyev rejects the clean version of the tenderloin dish, insisting it is missing the special tart ingredient from lunch.

scenes.title: Кто это сделал?  (Who Did This?)
scenes.summary: Barinov tells Nagiyev the truth about the secret ingredient, and Nagiyev storms into the kitchen to find out who put sheep droppings on his plate.

scenes.title: Работаем бесплатно  (Working for Free)
scenes.summary: Nagiyev docks a month's pay from Katya, Senya, Fedya, and Barinov, while Lyova nervously tries to tell Barinov about his rival restaurant interview.

scenes.title: Случай на парковке  (Incident in the Parking Lot)
scenes.summary: Elena and Katya argue fiercely in the parking lot after a near-miss with Katya's motorcycle, unaware that both are connected to Barinov.

scenes.title: Итоги спора  (Results of the Bet)
scenes.summary: Vika announces the shift tip totals, and Nastya unexpectedly beats both Ilya and Max to win the entire tip pool.

scenes.title: Коварный план Ильи  (Ilya's Cunning Plan)
scenes.summary: Ilya instructs an accomplice to plant a fake receipt in the bill folder and accuse Max of trying to cheat him, then steps out so Max will take the table.

scenes.title: Обед для адвоката  (Lunch for the Lawyer)
scenes.summary: During tense divorce negotiations with Kristina and her lawyer, Nagiyev orders Barinov to serve them two portions of the prank molecular dish.

scenes.title: Чужой столик  (Someone Else's Table)
scenes.summary: Max greets Ilya's accomplice at the table, but passes the order to waitress Sasha so he won't be accused of stealing Ilya's regular.

scenes.title: Цена выбора  (The Price of a Choice)
scenes.summary: Ilya's setup backfires and gets waitress Sasha fired by Nagiyev, while Max reflects on the choices people make every day.
